headline: Almost 13 billion zloty in half a year. Poland's commercial real estate market posts best result in years
summary: Commercial real estate investment in Poland exceeded 3 billion euros in the first half of 2026, up 71% year on year. It was the best first-half result since 2018, according to Colliers.
why: Commercial property investment volumes indicate capital flows into office, retail and logistics assets, which affect listed real estate and lenders financing these deals.
